services.name: Boat Rental
services.desc: Embrace the freedom of Wake County's waterways with our versatile boat rental options, catering to every type of voyager. Whether you're heart is set on a leisurely cruise with our roomy 22 ft South Bay pontoon, or chasing the thrill of speed on our high-performance speedboats, we have you covered. Our fishing boats are fully outfitted for those angling for a day of reeling in catches, featuring life jackets and optional fishing gear. Prefer a tranquil family outing? Relax on our well-kept pontoon, accommodating up to 12 guests and pet-friendly to boot (see add-ons for pricing).
